title: Custom Join&Leave Messages
description:
Mod removes default join/leave messages and makes custom ones.

Originally made for Comma.
body:
Mod removes default join/leave messages and makes custom ones.

config: customjoin.json

```
{
  "joinPrefix": "+",
  "joinPrefixColor": "GRAY",
  "joinMessage": "\u003cPlayer\u003e впал в кому",
  "joinPlayerColor": "WHITE",
  "joinMessageColor": "GRAY",
  "leavePrefix": "-",
  "leavePrefixColor": "GRAY",
  "leaveMessage": "У \u003cPlayer\u003e компьютер зависает и не реагирует",
  "leavePlayerColor": "WHITE",
  "leaveMessageColor": "GRAY"
}
```

Supported colors: BLACK, DARK_BLUE, DARK_GREEN, DARK_AQUA, DARK_RED, DARK_PURPLE, GOLD, GRAY, DARK_GRAY, BLUE, GREEN, AQUA, RED, LIGHT_PURPLE, YELLOW, WHITE.*

Compatible with Vanish by DrexHD.

Originally made for Comma.
